name: AddNoise node (sigma span renoise)
plain: Takes a NOISE source and adds it to a latent at a chosen sigma, outside the sampler. Lets you renoise a finished latent to re-enter sampling midway. Uses the span of the given sigmas as the amount, not the first sigma.
math:
scale = |σ_0 − σ_last| if len(sigmas)>1 else σ_0.
z' = process_latent_in(z) unless z is all zeros.
noisy = noise_scaling(scale, ε, z'), then process_latent_out, then NaN and inf replaced by 0.
label: from code
surprise: Scale is the difference between first and last sigma: passing a sigma list ending at 0 gives σ_0, ending at 5 gives σ_0−5, not σ_0.
